articles.title: Crypto investors are looking past market-cap rankings and back to fundamentals
articles.snippet: Investors are starting to judge crypto tokens on usage, economics and value capture rather than market-cap rank, industry executives said.

articles.title: Crypto wallet SafePal reveals a data breach exposing nearly 40,000 customers' order info
articles.snippet: While the data breach exposed the personal order details of thousands of customers, all private keys, seed phrases, and crypto assets remain completely safe.

articles.title: The stablecoin yield clash that won't go away has banks, crypto battling over tradition
articles.snippet: The bankers want people kept in lower-yield deposits for the good of the financial system as it's existed for generations, and their argument is gaining ground.

articles.title: The 'long bitcoin, short the bankers' era is officially over as TradFi giants embrace digital assets
articles.snippet: Financial firms are partnering with specialists to build infrastructure, blurring lines between traditional and decentralized finance into a unified sector.

articles.title: Robot maker Unitree is going public. Hyperliquid traders see 4x upside from IPO price
articles.snippet: Hyperliquid traders value Unitree at nearly $38 billion versus $9 billion at its IPO, leaving leveraged bets vulnerable when trading begins, Allium analysts said.
